reason: I need my phone within reach for the kids and emergencies, and the family-favourites workaround still means trusting a setup I have not tested at 3am. I already have a watch and a phone alarm, so 120 euro for a second device that does the same job feels like a luxury.
objection: If something happens with the kids at night I want my phone next to me, not in another room. A 120 euro bedside object does not change that, and the sleep and snoring estimate is nothing my watch does not already give me.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that the call-through from family works reliably every time, tested with my own phone, plus a lower price around 80 euro.
